simple.meaning: נָגַשׁ (nâgash) appears 125 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 18:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, flock, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָגַשׁ (H5066) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָגַשׁ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: נָגַשׁ (nâgash) / H5066 is tracked through Genesis 18:23, Genesis 19:9, Genesis 27:21, Genesis 27:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
